messages:
ara: FYI i opened a tiny docs PR (#3621) to clarify the eviction 'cooldown' behavior for Dedicated. some customers think cooldown=never-evict for that tenant; it's actually a scheduling backoff window. need a short callout + example and an SDK snippet.

mika: thanks. can you paste the YAML you added? want to check wording.

ara: here's the draft snippet:```yaml
provisioning:
  tenant_id: t-42
  reserved_pool: true
  eviction_cooldown_seconds: 600  # backoff before attempting to evict this tenant again
  sla:
    p95_latency_ms: 300
```

ara: current problem: line comment was ambiguous (said "prevents eviction for 10m"), which implies immunity. we should change to "delays additional eviction attempts for 10m" and show how cooldown interacts with tenant_priority + burst_policy.

oliver: agree. suggest a tiny callout: "Cooldown is a backoff not a guarantee. If cluster is overloaded and priority rules differ, eviction may still occur; cooldown only delays the next attempt for this tenant."

mika: add an SDK snippet too so customers can set this programmatically. i propose: `await client.dedicated.updateProvisioning(tenantId, {evictionCooldownSeconds: 600})`

ara: good. also added a terraform example for infra templates:```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_provision" "t42" {
  tenant_id = "t-42"
  reserved_pool = true
  eviction_cooldown_seconds = 600
}
```

mika: minor wording nit: replace "prevents" with "delays" in the intro and add a one-line pointer to the eviction ordering doc for details.

oliver: also add a short SLO measurement note: "When reporting token-level latency, exclude time windows where eviction is in-flight or retries occur; use the `eviction_events` metric to filter traces."

ara: added both. docs-bot can you run a link-check for `/dedicated/provisioning` and `/eng-runtime/eviction-ordering`?

docs-bot: running quick link-check... found 1 stale anchor: `/dedicated/autoscale#cooldown` -> suggested `/dedicated/provisioning#eviction-cooldown`. commented on PR #3621.

ci-bot: docs linter queued for PR #3621 (check for 'prevents' wording and terraform HCL lint).

ci-bot: linter passed. staging build queued.

ara: pushed update, changed wording to "delays additional eviction attempts", added SDK/terraform snippets, and linked to `/eng-runtime/eviction-ordering`.

mika: LGTM. one tiny ask: can we include a misconfiguration example where cooldown is set too low and causes thrash? two lines showing bad vs good.

ara: added quick bad/good snippet:```yaml
# bad: very short cooldown -> can cause eviction thrash
eviction_cooldown_seconds: 30
# good: moderate cooldown to allow graceful recovery
eviction_cooldown_seconds: 600
```

oliver: perfect. approved from my side.

deploy-bot: PR #3621 merged into main by ara at 1768001600. docs deployed to staging. :rocket:

mika: will ping #support with a short note so they can update runbooks. thanks all!
